newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent retraces losses on OPEC rollover report.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent retraces losses on OPEC rollover report.

text.p: - IPE Brent rebounded 20 cents in late afternoon trade after a Gulf source said that OPEC has no plans to increase output quotas at its next meeting in November.
At 1715 GMT, Nov Brent stood at $23.78 a barrel, having jumped on the news and then drifted slightly lower.
The contract was previously languishing near a session low of $23.58 after gas oil had lead the market sharply lower.
A Gulf source said on Thursday that OPEC's best option was to extend its current 25.033 million barrel per day output ceiling for the group's 11 members.
